mapping.draft_py:
# Blood for Bones (M20).
# s1 (compiled, kept): "As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature."
# s2: "Return a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield, then return another creature
#      card from your graveyard to your hand."
# Two non-targeted returns in printed order: Experimental Overload's CHOOSE-from-your-graveyard
# MOVE_ZONE (B5c-then-return-is) with Rise Again's creature filter and battlefield destination
# (B5b-return-creatures-battlefield), then the same CHOOSE to your hand. "another" holds by
# construction: the first card has left the graveyard before the second choice.
base = compiled[0]
to_battlefield = A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
    'cards': Selector(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
    ),
    'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
})
to_hand = A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
    'cards': Selector(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
    ),
    'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
})
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=base.kind,
        effect=Seq(steps=(to_battlefield, to_hand)),
        additional_costs=base.additional_costs,
    ),
]
